Assuming you meant **"What is the square root of 2?"** (or **"24"** / **"25"** due to adjacent keys):

* **$\sqrt{2}$** $\approx \mathbf{1.41421356}$ (an irrational number)
* **$\sqrt{24}$** $= 2\sqrt{6} \approx \mathbf{4.89897949}$
* **$\sqrt{25}$** $= \mathbf{5}$ (or $\pm 5$)

Let me know if you meant a different number!
